title: Slieveanee Mountain Hudson Memorial

external_narratives.summary: Detailed WartimeNI archive page for Lockheed Hudson T9328 crash at Slieveanee Mountain, Co. Antrim on 16 October 1940. All 5 crew from 224 Squadron based at RAF Aldergrove were killed. Three crew (F/L Francis Scott, P/O Ronald Davies, F/O Tony Tisdall) are buried at St Catherine's Church of Ireland, Killead-Aldergrove.
key_details: Three crew buried at St Catherine's Church, Killead-Aldergrove
F/L Francis Scott, P/O Ronald Davies from Dorset, F/O Tony Tisdall from Hendon

narrative: Lockheed Hudson T9328 crash at Slieveanee Mountain, Co. Antrim - WartimeNI On 16th October 1940, Lockheed Hudson T9328 crashed at Slieveanee Mountain, Cargan, Co. Over the years, local aviation groups have removed much of the wreckage. At the time, the British plane was with R.A.F. 224 Squadron, based nearby at , Co. All 5 crew members died at the scene as a result of the incident. Aged 24 years old. From Dorsetshire. Aged 24 years old. From Derbyshire. Aged 21 years old. From Hendon, Middlesex. The graves of Flight Lieutenant St. Catherine’s Church of Ireland , Killead, Co. Pilot Officer Ronald John Davies died on 16th October when Lockheed Hudson T9328 of R.A.F. 224 Squadron came down on Slieveanee Mountain.
